answer: Proof-of-burn resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to destroy native tokens at an unspendable address before minting a non-transferable identity credential. Rather than relying on a legacy keypair relic, this irreversible burn imposes a verifiable capital cost per clone across an agent's operational voyage. Raising entry onto a high cost mesa blocks free account farms, though well-funded adversaries can still absorb the burn fee to purchase multiple identities.
